inclusions.text: Return flights and all logistics (Base package)
inclusions.source: The tour comes in three tiers, so you only pay for what you want: a Base package (return flights, private transfers, Egyptologist guide, water, and all logistics); Base + Entrance Fees (the same, plus admission to Giza, the Grand Egyptian Museum, and the Citadel); and Base + Entrance Fees & Lunch (those entrance fees plus a midday meal).
